findings.highlight: don’t go too far
findings.evidenceJa: 深追いはするな
findings.governingReading: Shirou tells Saber not to pursue Rider too deeply.
findings.explanation: The English turns a tactical limit on pursuit into a vague limit on physical distance.

findings.highlight: smack away all the shadows
findings.evidenceJa: 影をすべてモップで叩き斬る
findings.governingReading: Shirou strikes and cuts down every attacking shadow with the Strengthened mop.
findings.explanation: Smack away removes the cutting force that explains the improvised weapon’s effectiveness and breakage.

findings.highlight: Shinji reaches out to fling my arms off. I kick his arms away
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の腕を振り解こうと手を伸ばす慎二。その腕を
findings.governingReading: Shinji reaches out one arm to throw off Shirou’s hold; Shirou immediately kicks that same arm.
findings.explanation: Plural arms obscures the single limb that Shirou then pins against the wall and breaks.

findings.highlight: I take my other arm and grab his throat.
findings.evidenceJa: まだ動く腕で慎二の喉を掴む
findings.governingReading: Shirou grabs Shinji’s throat with an arm that can still move despite his wounds.
findings.explanation: Other invents a left/right contrast and removes the emphasis on how little of Shirou’s injured body remains usable.

findings.highlight: there’s no problem with killing other magi.
findings.evidenceJa: 同じ魔術師なら、殺す事に抵抗なんてない
findings.governingReading: Shirou recognizes that he himself feels no resistance to killing an opponent who is likewise a magus, and briefly pities Shinji for never learning even that elementary reality.
findings.explanation: The English turns Shirou’s alarming first-person lack of resistance into an impersonal magus rule declaring that killing other magi is unobjectionable.

findings.highlight: Shinji screams to Rider in the distance.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠く離れたライダーへ叫ぶ慎二。
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese ends with Shinji’s spoken warning that his life is in danger; the explanatory narration is commented out.
findings.explanation: The Classic branch restores superseded narration and fixes Rider at a distance despite the active scene leaving the beat to staging.

findings.highlight: the church in Shinto
findings.evidenceJa: 新都の教会
findings.governingReading: Shirou directs Shinji to the church in Shinto, Fuyuki’s new-city district.
findings.explanation: Shinto reads as the religion rather than the established place name, damaging Fuyuki geography.

findings.highlight: you actually constructed this to beat the other Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 身を守る為に結界を張ったっていうのは嘘か
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks whether Shinji lied about erecting the field for self-protection.
findings.explanation: The Classic branch adds a specific motive of defeating the other Masters that Shirou does not state.

findings.highlight: worked with a Servant
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントを従えていれば
findings.governingReading: Shinji believed that becoming a Master and keeping a Servant under his command might make him a magus.
findings.explanation: Worked with recasts hierarchy and control as neutral cooperation, weakening both Shinji’s motive and his relationship with Rider.

findings.highlight: have that arm cut off.
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪を捨てないのなら、俺が剥ぎ取る
findings.governingReading: Shirou threatens to strip the Command Spells away if Shinji will not relinquish them.
findings.explanation: The mature branch specifies amputating Shinji’s arm, an action absent from the line and central to why his puzzled response is misleadingly reframed.

findings.highlight: Shinji questions like it’s a real mystery.
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二は心底不思議そうに首を傾げる
findings.governingReading: Shinji tilts his head with an expression of genuine, profound puzzlement.
findings.explanation: The English is malformed, omits the visible head tilt, and weakens the sincerity of the reaction.

findings.highlight: to Saber’s voice
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの叱咤に
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s trained body reacts to Saber’s sharp warning before his brain does.
findings.explanation: Voice removes the rebuking urgency that triggers his reflexive retreat.

findings.highlight: But please be rest assured.
findings.evidenceJa: ですがご安心を
findings.governingReading: Rider courteously tells Shinji to rest assured before asserting confidence in her Noble Phantasm and charge.
findings.explanation: Please be rest assured is ungrammatical and mars Rider’s controlled, formal confidence.

findings.highlight: For some reason
findings.evidenceJa: あろうことか
findings.governingReading: To everyone’s astonishment, Rider does the unthinkable and presses the dagger to her own neck.
findings.explanation: For some reason changes shocked evaluation into uncertainty about motive.

findings.highlight: Slashes it in one breath.
findings.evidenceJa: それを、一気に切り裂いた
findings.governingReading: Rider slashes her neck open in one swift motion.
findings.explanation: In one breath substitutes an unrelated bodily measure for the speed and decisiveness of the stroke.

findings.highlight: the neck of the black-garbed Rider
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い装束に身を包んだライダーの白い首筋
findings.governingReading: Blood gushes from Rider’s white neck against her black clothing.
findings.explanation: The omission removes the stark white-black-red visual contrast structuring the image.

findings.highlight: Rider will lose large amounts of blood and will just disappear.
findings.evidenceJa: 自ら消滅するだけではないのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether Rider will merely lose a great quantity of blood and erase herself.
findings.explanation: The English promotes his fearful prediction into a certain future event immediately before the blood behaves otherwise.

findings.highlight: But that’s just a needless worry for people who know nothing.
findings.evidenceJa: だが、それは知らぬ者だけの杞憂。
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese moves directly from Shirou’s alarm to the blood stopping in midair; this knowing aside is commented out.
findings.explanation: The Classic branch restores a superseded omniscient aside that belittles the viewpoint character’s reasonable uncertainty and preempts the reveal.

findings.highlight: A creature-like figure that looks creepy.
findings.evidenceJa: たとえようもなく禍々しい、生き物のような図形
findings.governingReading: The blood forms an indescribably ominous, living-creature-like figure.
findings.explanation: Looks creepy trivializes the malign visual presence and flattens its intensity.

findings.highlight: A big lump of magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 強大な魔力の塊
findings.governingReading: Rider creates a mass of immense magical power.
findings.explanation: Big lump is crude, physically comic diction for the concentrated magical force overwhelming the corridor.

findings.highlight: seems small compared to this
findings.evidenceJa: 子供騙しとさえ思える
findings.governingReading: The prior bounded field now seems like a mere child’s trick beside this circle.
findings.explanation: Small preserves relative scale but removes Shirou’s judgment that the earlier field looks like a sham for children.

findings.highlight: You will be in the way if you stand there
findings.evidenceJa: そこにいては巻き込まれる
findings.governingReading: Saber warns that Shirou will be caught in Rider’s Noble Phantasm if he remains there.
findings.explanation: In the way makes Shirou an obstruction or inconvenience rather than a person in the attack’s danger zone.

findings.highlight: I will just defeat you here
findings.evidenceJa: ここで引導を渡すだけだ
findings.governingReading: Saber warns that if Rider will engulf even her own Master, Saber will give her the final rites here—finish her decisively.
findings.explanation: Defeat removes the lethal finality of Saber’s threat and softens her response to endangering a Master.

findings.highlight: I am just going to run taking my Master with me.
findings.evidenceJa: 私はマスターを連れて逃げるだけよ
findings.governingReading: Rider says she will simply take her Master and flee.
findings.explanation: Run taking is conspicuously non-English and disrupts Rider’s poised rebuttal.

findings.highlight: I feel like something is blazing through the hallway
findings.evidenceJa: 巨大な光の矢じみたものが、とてつもないスピードで廊下を駆け抜けていったのだと
findings.governingReading: Even with his eyes closed, Shirou is forced to feel that something like a giant arrow of light has raced through the corridor at tremendous speed.
findings.explanation: I feel like turns forced sensory apprehension of a completed passage into a casual, uncertain impression and loses the past completion.

findings.highlight: remains of cruel destruction
findings.evidenceJa: そこにあるのは無惨な破壊の跡だった
findings.governingReading: What remains before Shirou is a ghastly trail of destruction.
findings.explanation: The English predication is malformed and cruel destruction misstates 無惨な as morally cruel rather than惨状-like devastation.

findings.highlight: The firing hammer that was pulled inside me is released.
findings.evidenceJa: 頭の中で打ち付けられていた撃鉄が戻っていく
findings.governingReading: The firing hammer that had been striking inside Shirou’s head returns to its resting state.
findings.explanation: Pulled then released reverses the source mechanism and breaks the image’s connection to the earlier hammer being driven or struck.
